summary.text: Archie Thomas is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 86, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A Hamilton businessman, he advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Wayne Rusk in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Archie Thomas earned a high school diploma from Hamilton High School and lists his career as a businessman, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a native Montanan and Hamilton businessman of more than 40 years who filed as a Democrat but characterized himself as a fiscally conservative former Republican.
Thomas said in the survey that his priorities are Montana's housing costs, health care system and tax system, which he called unfair, along with a return to what he termed normal governance.
